subject: Community Spotlight — contributor access credit pool request
messages:
From: Julia Park <julia@brightletter.co>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: partners@brightletter.co
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Community Spotlight — small access pool for contributor preview

Hi Soojin,

Loved the demo last week — our editorial team is planning a 'Community Spotlight' December edition and we'd like to invite 12 of our top contributors to try Redwood during a soft preview. Would Redwood be open to providing a small allocation of complimentary trial credits for those contributors (short-lived accounts with ~30k token allotment each, valid for 14 days)? The goal is to let them experiment and drop short quotes for the newsletter.

We're asking for: 12 complimentary trial accounts (30k tokens each) for 14 days, plus a single invite link and a one-paragraph blurb we can include in the email. I've attached a short partner-request form with the list and suggested send date (Dec 08).

If that's possible, we can include Redwood as the exclusive inference partner in the edition and add a backlink. Happy to do a quick call tomorrow if it's easier.

Thanks,

Julia Park
Partnerships Lead 
BrightLetter
[julia@brightletter.co]

Attachment: partner-request-form.pdf (pdf, 48KB)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Julia Park <julia@brightletter.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Community Spotlight — small access pool for contributor preview

Thanks Julia — this sounds like a clean, high-signal activation. Looping in Marissa (partnerships owner) and Ben (ops/finance) to confirm allocation and any guardrails.

Marissa / Ben — quick context: BrightLetter wants 12 short-lived trial accounts (30k tokens each) for contributor previews, start date Dec 8, duration 14 days. They offered exclusive partner placement in the edition. Requested assets attached.

Questions for ops before we confirm publicly:
- Can we provision trials scoped to only generation endpoints (no embedding exports) for these accounts?
- Any billing or TOS flags for short-lived trial batches to external influencers?
- If we approve, do we want to cap total token burn or suspend after a collective threshold?

If you both approve, I'll send the invite link and the blurb back to Julia by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks —
Soojin Lee
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

Attachment referenced: partner-request-form.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 11:23:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Community Spotlight — small access pool for contributor preview

+1 from partnerships — I reviewed the request and it's aligned with our partner playbook. A few operational guardrails I recommend before sending: 

- Limit accounts to generation-only API keys (no embeddings or export).
- Each account: 30k token budget, expiration 14 days after activation.
- Collective cap: 360k tokens (12 * 30k) with automated suspension if collective usage hits 375k (5% buffer).
- Require contributors to agree to a brief 'quote permission' clause (one-liner) — I can provide language.

Attaching a small allocation sheet with the proposed account IDs and activation window. Ben — can you confirm we can create the batch and implement the collective cap mechanics? If yes, Soojin can confirm to BrightLetter and I'll draft the blurb.

Marissa Cole
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachment: alloc-table-Dec2026.xlsx (xlsx, 9KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 17:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Community Spotlight — small access pool for contributor preview

Thanks Marissa — ops can do this. Confirming the following implementation plan: 

1) We'll provision 12 trial accounts in the partner batch, each with a generation-only API key.
2) Per-account budget = 30,000 tokens. Collective hard cap = 375,000 tokens. Once the collective cap is hit, all trial keys will be disabled automatically.
3) Expiry: 14 days from activation; keys created but inactive until BrightLetter triggers invite link.
4) I'll add logging tags (partner:brightletter, campaign:community-spotlight-Dec2026) so we can trace usage.

Soho (Soojin) — please send the invite link and the blurb below to BrightLetter. Julia — tagging you on the distribution. Let me know if you want the keys rotated after first use.

Blurb (feel free to edit):
"Try Redwood Inference — BrightLetter readers get early access to a curated preview of our text generation platform. Each contributor gets a 14-day trial with a 30k token allotment to experiment and share feedback. Redeem via this invite link."

Ben Carter
Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
